name: query expansion pipeline
definition: Query expansion (v0.9.0) rewrites the user query into 2-3 variants via an LLM. Variant searches run alongside the original; results are fused downstream by the recall waterfall. The pipeline honors the resummerize backend-selection path so operators can swap providers without touching expansion code.

revisions.definition: Query expansion rewrites the user query into variants for multi-query search. Intended to cover lexical gaps between the query and indexed content.

Query expansion rewrites queries into 2-3 variants using Gemini Flash Lite. The expansion worker writes to a shared channel consumed by the recall waterfall. Stopword filtering and query-type-specific templates were considered but rejected as subjective params.

Query expansion (v0.9.0) rewrites into 2-3 variants via Gemini Flash Lite or OMLX. The variant searches run in parallel with the original. Early bench showed 17% recall lift on the LongMemEval exploratory category. Strong-signal queries bypass expansion when the BM25 top-1 score exceeds a learned threshold.

name: sqlite-vec HNSW cache
definition: The sqlite-vec HNSW cache is rein's vector side index: 3072-dim cosine embeddings backing approximate nearest neighbor at recall time. Side-index refresh is triggered by every write and by the v0.23 resummerize rewrite path. The dirty-marker lifecycle is load-bearing: only full rebuilds clear the .dirty flag.

revisions.definition: sqlite-vec HNSW cache holds 3072-dim cosine embeddings for approximate nearest neighbor search over stored memories.

sqlite-vec HNSW cache: embeddings live in the sqlite-vec extension table; the usearch HNSW instance is rebuilt on startup from that table. Side-index refresh runs fire-and-forget on every store/update/delete to keep the HNSW in sync. A per-request connection model avoids a shared mutex on the HNSW handle.
